demos.title: Synchronous golden path
demos.purpose: Observe Storefront, real Gateway request/backend dependency, Orders, Inventory and safe JDBC/Redis CLIENT spans.

demos.title: Portal SSR versus SPA
demos.purpose: Show actual independently instrumented SSR and browser roots; explain only observed root boundaries.

demos.title: Inbound Gateway context
demos.purpose: Run valid, absent, malformed and unsampled wire cases without rewriting flags or minting Gateway spans.

demos.title: Trusted business invocation identity
demos.purpose: Replace untrusted identity, accept a trusted valid value and prove exact business lookup over HTTP and Service Bus.

demos.title: Errors and timeouts
demos.requiresOwnerEffect: Approved native timeout/database error injection; not a shipped data-adapter fault switch
demos.purpose: Show injected Inventory timeout/PostgreSQL error and native exception association without payload leakage.

demos.title: Service Bus retry attempts
demos.purpose: Declare N failures plus success as N+1 attempts and show every actual extra delivery rather than deduplicating.

demos.title: Dead-letter and replay
demos.purpose: Run actual Fulfillment and Notify DLQ cases; both new replay PROCESS and SEND roots link the original producer, never an ancient active parent or an invented PROCESS-to-SEND edge.

demos.title: Fan-out and linked fan-in
demos.purpose: Observe separate worker PROCESS attempts and bounded native Aggregator links to every persisted contributor.

demos.title: Event Hubs mixed-context batch
demos.purpose: Use bounded links from genuinely different traces; the first item is never chosen as parent.

demos.title: CloudEvents and Storage Queue
demos.purpose: Observe W3C extensions/envelope continuity, exact size/schema limits and native duplicate-delivery handling.

demos.title: Spoofed message context
demos.purpose: Show actual trust-boundary rejection/new root, bounded safe category, no rejected personal input.

demos.title: Data-tier safety
demos.purpose: Show real JDBC and Redis logical CLIENT operations and raw-schema privacy scanning with source-bound negative controls.

demos.title: Identity and privacy
demos.purpose: Show HMAC pseudonym and bounded authentication outcome; real Entra/signature/privacy signoffs remain required.

demos.title: Orphan-candidate triage
demos.purpose: Classify every actual candidate with evidence; unexplained cases remain defects, never disappear by filtering.

demos.title: Sampling, load and rollback
demos.purpose: Show bounded native sampling admission/drain/restore, actual load metrics and reviewed production rollback, not 100% settings alone.
